description: Returns the complete dossier for a project across eleven sections: overview, siting and land, power and interconnection, energization ramp, 8760 load profile, behind-the-meter generation, electrical connection, capital, assessment, local records, and sources. Pass any project name, alias, canonical ID, queue ID, or developer plus place.

include_hourly.description: When false (default), returns the 8,760 load profile summary only. When true, includes the chronological hourly 8,760 series capped at max_hourly_points.

location.description: Optional city, county, or state to disambiguate projects (e.g. 'Dallas, TX', 'Abilene, TX').

max_hourly_points.description: Maximum number of hourly points to return when include_hourly is true (default: 8760, max: 8760).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Map project ID, canonical ID, or queue ID (e.g. 'P003', 'P017', 'CVP0003').

project_name.description: Project or campus name or alias (e.g. 'Hyperion – Richland Parish', 'Stargate Abilene', 'DFW1').

query.description: Free-text project reference, developer + place, or alias (e.g. 'QTS Atlanta', 'Meta New Albany').

sections.description: Optional list of sections to return. Defaults to all 11 sections: ['overview', 'siting_land', 'power_interconnection', 'energization_ramp', 'load_profile_8760', 'btm_generation', 'electrical_connection', 'capital', 'assessment', 'local_records', 'sources'].

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to disambiguate projects (e.g. 'TX', 'LA', 'OH').

name: get_project_details

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Get Project Details
